1496-4499-8160.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Kwia.
When Kwia enters, Verdant Sun's Avatar triggers, causing you to gain life.
Kwia triggers, creating a Lotus token.
Activate the Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {3}.
Repeat.

2060-2113-4687.notablePrerequisites: Crystalline Crawler has at least four counters on it.
2060-2113-4687.description:
Activate Gilder Bairn using its ability from Karametra's Favor by tapping it, adding one mana.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler as many times as necessary by removing counters from it, adding at least two mana.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite counters on Crystalline Crawler, you may instead double the counters on any other permanents.

262-767-4687.notablePrerequisites: Druids' Repository has at least four counters on it.
262-767-4687.description:
Activate Elemental Mastery by tapping Gilder Bairn, producing its effect.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on Druids' Repository.
Activate Druids' Repository as many times as necessary by removing counters from it, adding at least three mana.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite counters on Druids' Repository, you may instead double the counters on any other permanents.

1793-6249-6495--5.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, it and Harvester of Souls trigger.
Resolve the Harvester of Souls trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
1793-6249-6495--5.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

2018-6495--73.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the persist or undying creature.
When the creature dies, its persist or undying ability triggers if it doesn't have a -1/-1 counter or +1/+1 counter on it respectively, and Luminous Broodmoth triggers if the creature didn't have flying.
Resolve the persist or undying trigger, if applicable, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with either a -1/-1 counter or a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Luminous Broodmoth trigger, if applicable, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it if the creature is still in your graveyard.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
2018-6495--73.notes:
You must choose a persist or undying creature that does not have flying - otherwise the Luminous Broodmoth triggers do not occur.
If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

7073-7936.easyPrerequisites:
Pramikon and Dominion Saboteur are naming different directions.
You have at least two opponents.
7073-7936.description: Because Dominion Saboteur and Pramikon disagree on the direction in which players can attack, players are unable to attack at all so long as there are three or more players.
7073-7936.notes: Here is a relevant ruling from Pramikon relating to this lock: "If two Pramikons on the battlefield disagree on which direction three or more players must attack, players can't attack at all. (2019-08-23)"

4009-4574-4659-4750-6842.notablePrerequisites:
There must be at least one +1/+1 counter each on Arcbound Reclaimer and at least two additional artifacts.
You control at least three artifacts.
4009-4574-4659-4750-6842.description:
Cast Mox Opal by paying its mana cost.
When you cast that spell, Flux Channeler triggers, putting one +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer and at least two additional artifacts you control.
Activate Mox Opal by tapping it, adding mana.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Mox Opal, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Mox Opal from your graveyard on top of your library.
Activate Iron Spider's last ability by paying {2} and removing two +1/+1 counters from artifacts you control, drawing Mox Opal.
Repeat.

341-1621-1895-6867.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Wispweaver Angel with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Wispweaver Angel from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Wispweaver Angel enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

728-2577-2757.description:
Activate a basic Swamp by tapping it, adding {B}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Grimgrin, untapping the basic Swamp.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Gravecrawler, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-1170-7525.description:
Cast a copy of the prepared spell from exile by paying one mana, unpreparing Pigment Wrangler // Striking Palette.
When you cast this, Displacer Kitten and Birgi, God of Storytelling triggers, adding {R}.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten ability, flickering Pigment Wrangler // Striking Palette, which enters prepared.
Resolve the spell from step 1.
Repeat.

1003-2173-2829-5220.description:
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Phyrexian Walker
When Phyrexian Walker dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Phyrexian Walker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability.
Cast Phyrexian Walker from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

104-1939-3197.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-1939-3197.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Lunarch Veteran triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat from step 2.

511-817-3921-4050-6753.description:
Activate Fungal Bloom by paying {G}{G}, putting two spore counters on a Fungus you control.
Activate a Fungus by removing two spore counters from it, creating two 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing two Saprolings, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat.

3327-4613-5073-6602.notablePrerequisites: You have sacrificed at least three artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
3327-4613-5073-6602.description:
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Tromell.
Activate Dargo using Tinder Wall's ability by sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}.
Choose to return Dargo from your graveyard to the command zone.
Repeat.

1690-2538-5034-6259.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact card in hand that can be cast for {0} due to Samut.
1690-2538-5034-6259.description:
Activate Sol Ring by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Words of Wind by paying {1}.
Cast an artifact by paying {0}.
Jhoira triggers, causing each player to return a permanent they control from the battlefield to their hand due to Words of Wind, with you returning Sol Ring to your hand.
Activate Words of Wind by paying {1}.
Cast Sol Ring by paying {0}.
Jhoira triggers, causing each player to return a permanent they control from the battlefield to their hand due to Words of Wind, with you returning the artifact cast in step 3 to your hand.
Repeat.
1690-2538-5034-6259.notes: You can use a historic creature to get infinite ETB and LTB triggers. If you do not use a creature, this combo will not produce those results.

2438-4681-4894-6542.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing Breaching Hippocamp, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Breaching Hippocamp from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Breaching Hippocamp enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
Repeat.

643-1429-5256-5402.notablePrerequisites: Lesser Masticore does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
643-1429-5256-5402.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies,  its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters the battlefield, Captain Storm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

710-2438-4775.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Danitha.
When Danitha dies, Necrogen Communion triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Necrogen Communion from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

4499-6111.notablePrerequisites: Elves you control can tap to produce at least {3}.
4499-6111.description:
Activate any number of Elves you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}.
Each Elf tapped this way triggers, untapping it and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Dionus, thus granting a fresh instance of the ability to each Elf you control.
Repeat.

2452-3249-5670-5933--56.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
2452-3249-5670-5933--56.description:
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast a Zombie from your graveyard this turn.
Cast the Zombie from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Rooftop Storm.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the Zombie.
When the Zombie dies, Popular Egotist triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and an opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

144-2062-5434.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2 greater than the largest life total among your opponents.
144-2062-5434.description:
Cast Ashcloud Phoenix by paying {1}{R}{R}.
When Ashcloud Phoenix enters the battlefield, Marauding Raptor triggers, dealing 2 damage to it.
Ashcloud Phoenix dies as a state-based action due to having less than 0 toughness.
Ashcloud Phoenix's first ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down.
When Ashcloud Phoenix enters the battlefield face-down, Marauding Raptor triggers, dealing 2 damage to it.
Ashcloud Phoenix dies as a state-based action due to having less than 0 toughness.
Yarus' second ability triggers, returning Ashcloud Phoenix from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down, and then turning it face-up.
Marauding Raptor and Ashcloud Phoenix's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Ashcloud Phoenix trigger, dealing 2 damage to each player.
Resolve the Marauding Raptor trigger, dealing 2 damage to Ashcloud Phoenix.
Repeat from step 3.

1263-2034-3537.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Bog Initiate by paying {1}, adding {B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Repeat.

369-1052-2034.notablePrerequisites: Minion's Return attached to Iridescent Drake.
369-1052-2034.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Iridescent Drake, adding {C}{C}.
When Iridescent Drake dies, Minion's Return triggers, returning Iridescent Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Iridescent Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Minion's Return from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Iridescent Drake.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more +1/+1 counters on it

1887-3693-4120.easyPrerequisites: Walking Ballista has a +1/+1 counter on it.
1887-3693-4120.description:
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter on it, targeting itself, but putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Vigor.
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter on it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.
1887-3693-4120.notes: You may also target your other creatures in step 2 to put +1/+1 counters on them due to Vigor.

524-1379-4246.description:
Aether Storm prevents creature spells from being cast.
Null Rod prevents Aether Storm's ability from being activated to destroy it.

1170-3923-5116.description:
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Cast Mystic Speculation with buyback by paying {2}{U}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Gilded Lotus.
Resolve Mystic Speculation, causing you to scry 3 and return it to your hand.
Repeat.

2104-2761-3198.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Glitterfang by paying {R}.
Cast Lore Drakkis for its mutate cost by paying {U/R}{U/R}, putting it under Glitterfang.
Lore Drakkis triggers, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
At the beginning of your end step, Glitterfang triggers, returning itself and Lore Drakkis from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

415-1642-3059.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Xathrid Demon triggers, causing you to sacrifice Malignus and causing each opponent to lose life equal to Malignus's power.
At the beginning of your end step, Warlock Class triggers, causing each opponent to lose life equal to the amount of life they lost this turn.
Each opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

2816-3809-5184-5309.notablePrerequisites:
Umbral Mantle attached to Black Market Tycoon.
Black Market Tycoon does not have summoning sickness.
2816-3809-5184-5309.description:
Activate Black Market Tycoon by tapping it, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}.
Activate Black Market Tycoon by paying {3} and untapping it, giving itself +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

614-1518-1987.notablePrerequisites:
Will Kenrith has at least two loyalty counters.
You control an artifact and/or land that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {U}.
614-1518-1987.description:
Activate Will's second ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing target player to draw two cards and causing all instant, sorcery and planeswalker spells you cast to cost {2} less this turn.
Activate the aritfact and/or land by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking Nucklavee and the artifact and/or land.
Nucklavee enters the battlefield, triggering its first and second ability.
Resolve the first trigger, choosing not to return any red sorcery to your hand.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from the graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
